events.text: Endrass began his naval career.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Endrass began his naval career in April 1935 .

events.text: Endrass was assigned to the U-boat force.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he was assigned in October 1937 to the U-boat force .

events.text: Endrass joined as Leutnant zur See.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He joined in December 1938 as Leutnant zur See .

events.text: Endrass was Watch Officer when Günther Prien penetrated the defences at Scapa Flow and sank the battleship.
events.subject: self
events.quote: penetrated the defences at Scapa Flow attack and sank the battleship in October 1939

events.text: Endrass remained on U-47 until May 1940.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Endrass remained on U-47 until May 1940

events.text: Endrass left and took over command from Herbert Sohler.
events.subject: self
events.quote: when he left and took over command of from the relatively unsuccessful Herbert Sohler

events.text: Endrass received the Oak Leaves to his Knights Cross.
events.subject: self
events.object: Oak Leaves to his Knights Cross
events.quote: Five patrols later he received the Oak Leaves to his Knights Cross

events.text: The presentation of the Oak Leaves was made by Adolf Hitler at the Führer Headquarter Wolfsschanze in Rastenburg.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The presentation was made on 30 June 1941 by Adolf Hitler at the Führer Headquarter Wolfsschanze

events.text: Endrass left U-46.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In September 1941 Endrass left U-46

events.text: A month later Endrass took over a new command.
events.subject: self
events.quote: a month later took over

events.text: Endrass was killed while operating against Convoy HG 76.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he was killed on 21 December 1941 while operating against Convoy HG 76

events.text: Engelbert Endrass received the Wehrmacht Long Service Award 4th Class.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Wehrmacht Long Service Award 4th Class ( 5 April 1939 )

events.text: Engelbert Endrass received the Spanish Cross.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Spanish Cross ( 6 June 1939 )

events.text: Engelbert Endrass received the Iron Cross 2nd Class.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 2nd Class ( 25 September 1939 )

events.text: Engelbert Endrass received the Iron Cross 1st Class.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 1st Class ( 17 October 1939 )

events.text: Engelbert Endrass received the U-boat War Badge.
events.subject: self
events.quote: U-boat War Badge ( 1939 ) ( 19 December 1939 )

events.text: Engelbert Endrass received the U-boat War Badge with Diamonds.
events.subject: self
events.quote: with Diamonds ( 18 July 1941 )

events.text: Engelbert Endrass received the Italian Croce di Guerra with Swords.
events.subject: self
events.object: Italian Croce di Guerra with Swords
events.quote: Italian Croce di Guerra with Swords ( 1 November 1941 )

events.text: Engelbert Endrass received the Knights Cross as Oberleutnant zur See and commander of U-46.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Knights Cross on 5 September 1940 as Oberleutnant zur See and commander of U-46

events.text: Engelbert Endrass received the 14th Oak Leaves as Kapitänleutnant and commander of U-46.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 14th Oak Leaves on 10 June 1941 as Kapitänleutnant and commander of U-46
